# UMass Lowell

> > University of Massachusetts Lowell's official website providing information on academics, student programs, leadership, and campus resources.

UMass Lowell is a public research university in Massachusetts celebrating 125 years of education. The site features information about the Manning School of Business, Zuckerberg College of Health Sciences, Office of the Provost, signature student success programs, and extensive resources for prospective, accepted, and current students.

## Key Topics

- UMass Lowell
- Office of the Provost
- Manning School of Business
- Launch! Summer Program
- Student Success Programs
- First-Generation Students
- Experiential Learning
- Graduate and Professional Studies
- International Partnerships
- Academic Administration
- Core Curriculum
- Student Support Services
- Higher Education
- Zuckerberg College of Health Sciences
- 125th Anniversary

## Admissions and New Students

- [Accepted Students](https://www.uml.edu/accepted-students): Welcome page for accepted students with enrollment steps and Welcome Day info
- [Launch! Pre-College Students](https://www.uml.edu/academics/launch/pre-college-students): Launch! Summer programs for high school students including UPRISE & Liftoff
- [Launch! for FAHSS Admitted Students](https://www.uml.edu/academics/launch/admitted-students/fahss.aspx): Launch! Summer Program info for admitted FAHSS students at UMass Lowell

## Academic Programs and Student Success

- [Signature Programs](https://www.uml.edu/academics/provost-office/student-success/signature-programs.aspx): Student success programs including River Hawk Scholars Academy & Immersive
- [Graduate and Professional Studies](https://www.uml.edu/academics/provost-office/innovation-workforce): Graduate & Professional Studies programs and continuing education offerings
- [International Partnerships and Exchanges](https://www.uml.edu/academics/provost-office/international-partnerships): International partnerships, student exchanges, and global education programs
- [Core Curriculum: Breadth of Knowledge](https://www.uml.edu/academics/core-curriculum/bok.aspx): Breadth of Knowledge requirements for UMass Lowell core curriculum

## University Leadership

- [Bertie Greer, Dean of Manning School of Business](https://www.uml.edu/about/leadership/deans/greer-bertie.aspx): Profile of Bertie Greer, Dean of Manning School of Business at UMass Lowell
- [Luis M. Falcón, Dean of FAHSS](https://www.uml.edu/about/leadership/deans/falcon-luis.aspx): Profile of Luis M. Falcón, Dean Emeritus of FAHSS at UMass Lowell
- [Galadriel Chilton, Dean of University Library](https://www.uml.edu/about/leadership/deans/chilton-galadriel.aspx): Profile of Galadriel Chilton, Dean of University Library at UMass Lowell
- [Julie Nash, Senior Vice Provost for Academic Affairs](https://www.uml.edu/about/leadership/vice-provosts-chancellors/nash-julie.aspx): Profile of Julie Nash, Senior Vice Provost for Academic Affairs
- [Sarah Corbett, Associate VC of Marketing and Communications](https://www.uml.edu/about/leadership/corbett-sarah.aspx): Profile of Sarah Corbett, Associate VC of Marketing and Communications

## Student Support and Resources

- [Pregnant and Parenting Students](https://www.uml.edu/academics/provost-office/student-success/pregnant-parenting-students): Support resources and priority registration for pregnant & parenting students
- [Temporary Conditions Accommodations](https://www.uml.edu/accessibility/tempconditions.aspx): Academic accommodations process for students with temporary conditions

## University History and Milestones

- [Celebrating 125 Years](https://www.uml.edu/125): 125th anniversary celebration of UMass Lowell's history since 1894
- [History of Zuckerberg College of Health Sciences](https://www.uml.edu/125/college-histories/health-sciences.aspx): Historical overview of Zuckerberg College of Health Sciences development

- [MAPDN Resources for Assessment](https://www.uml.edu/academics/transformational-education/mapdn/resources-assessment.aspx): Assessment resources for Mass. educators via MAPDN professional development
